summary: Created shared makeProject() fixture factory in tests/gui/helpers/make-project.ts with structured MakeProjectOpts API (meta, work_packages, synthesis_generated, timing, ...rootOverrides).
Removed 6 diverged local makeProject() implementations across all project-detail-*.test.ts files and replaced with import from the shared helper.
Migrated all ~50 call sites across all 6 files to the new meta-namespaced API (e.g. { status: 'X' } → { meta: { status: 'X' } }).

Fixed D-12 mock-ordering bug in project-detail-runs.test.ts: moved vi.clearAllMocks() to execute BEFORE mock implementations in beforeEach, preventing mocks from being cleared immediately after setup.
Updated tests/gui/README.md: replaced the stale Option A/B discussion and makeProject() shape-divergence warning with documentation of the new shared helper API.

comments.note: tests/gui/helpers/ contains only make-project.ts. The create-namespaced-project.ts helper mentioned in the file-tree.md was already there but does not appear in the gui/ helpers directory — only in tests/helpers/ (server-side). The README.md previously mentioned no gui helpers/ directory. This discrepancy in naming/location is pre-existing and not introduced by WP-001.

project-detail-runs.test.ts is ~1490 lines and exercises many distinct behaviours for the same view script. Consider splitting it into focused sub-files (e.g. project-detail-resume-btn.test.ts, project-detail-polling.test.ts) to improve discoverability and reduce test-file cognitive load. Out of scope for WP-001.

project-detail-poll.test.ts uses makeProject() with 15 direct { meta: { status: '...' } } call sites but the poll test logic is tightly coupled to status transitions. A dedicated PollFixtures helper (makeInProgressProject, makeCompleteProject) would be more readable. Out of scope.

The MakeProjectOpts interface uses [key: string]: unknown as an index signature alongside typed optional fields. TypeScript will not error if callers accidentally pass an unexpected root key (e.g. makeProject({ statues: 'COMPLETE' }) — a typo). A discriminated or stricter type would provide better feedback, but the current form is a pragmatic balance for test fixtures.

[documentation-forward] MakeProjectOpts uses [key: string]: unknown as an index signature alongside the named optional fields.
